target.resolutionSource: CMS Care Compare nursing home Provider Information file (NH_ProviderInfo), all certified facilities: sum of Average Number of Residents per Day divided by sum of Number of Certified Beds
target.resolutionRule: Resolve to national nursing-home occupancy computed from the first NH_ProviderInfo file CMS posts at the Care Compare refresh scheduled for 2026-07-29 (per the dataset metastore next-update field): the sum of 'Average Number of Residents per Day' divided by the sum of 'Number of Certified Beds' across all rows with both fields populated, expressed as a percent rounded to two decimals. If CMS posts the refresh on a different calendar day, use the first file posted at that refresh; ignore later monthly refreshes. June 2026 file reference computation: 1,247,110 residents / 1,563,726 beds = 79.75 percent.
